quotes.text: ClinEnv is built from MIMIC-IV v3.1 ( Johnson et al., 2023a ) and MIMIC-IV-Note v2.2 ( Johnson et al., 2023b ).
Because every stage is built deterministically from logged events, the ground truth can always be traced back to the originating row.

parsed.rationale: The paper names the source datasets with versions (MIMIC-IV v3.1, MIMIC-IV-Note v2.2) and the PhysioNet platform. It gives a route from each task to its source record through subject_id/hadm_id keys, event provenance and row-level traceability of ground truth.
